meta.description: Implement scoped frontend changes: components, hooks, routing, styling, client-side state. Reads docs/current_task.xml for exact scope.
meta.trigger_phrases: implement UI, build the component, update the form, add the page, style the layout, fix the frontend, add the hook, build the view

steps.step: Read docs/Purpose.xml, docs/context.xml, docs/current_task.xml. First reply must restate: - Task goal (one sentence) - Files you will modify (exact paths from docs/current_task.xml files_in_scope) - API shapes and types you will consume (from docs/context.xml or src/lib/types) If required type or API shape is absent — output BLOCKED, stop.

Output implementation plan before writing any code: - Component tree or hook structure - State management approach (local vs store) - How loading, error, and empty states are handled - Tests you will add If plan requires scope change — stop, await engineer confirmation.

constraints.item: Modify only files in docs/current_task.xml files_in_scope.
No business logic in components — call a service, hook, or util.
No invented mock services, fake API responses, or placeholder data.
No invented backend endpoints, env vars, or DB schema.
No `any` without inline justification comment on the same line.
Handle loading, error, and empty states in every data-fetching component.
Use shared types from src/lib/types — do not duplicate definitions.
No console.log, TODOs, or commented-out code in the diff.
No mock/stub code unless labeled: // MOCK — remove before merge

steps.step: Write or update tests: - Component renders correctly (happy path) - Error state renders correctly - Key user interaction: click, submit, or input Run: npm run test -- --testPathPattern=[changed-file] Report actual test output — do not summarize.
End reply with: files_changed: [list] tests_run: [command + actual output] remaining_unknowns: [list or "none"] docs_drift: [stale docs/context.xml fields or "none"]

stop_and_ask.condition: Required API shape or type absent from docs/context.xml or src/lib/types.
Task requires touching backend or out-of-scope files.
Backend behavior change needed to satisfy the UI requirement.

escalation.path: Switch to orchestrator. Do not implement backend changes yourself.
Surface to orchestrator to update docs/context.xml or src/lib/types first.
Switch to reviewer. Pass the diff and docs/current_task.xml acceptance criteria.
